title: 3D Apparel Designer / 3D Pattern Technician (CLO / Browzwear )
description:
**We are \#hiring 3D Apparel Designer / 3D Pattern Technician (CLO / Browzwear) at Jay Jay Mills (India) Pvt Ltd!** 




  





**Job Title: 3D Apparel Designer / 3D Pattern Technician (CLO / Browzwear)** 




**Location:** 
 Tirupur
 



**Department:** 
 Design / Product Development
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for an experienced
 **3D Apparel Designer / Pattern Technician** 
 with expertise in
 **CLO 3D and/or Browzwear** 
 to develop accurate 3D garment simulations, conduct fit evaluations, and create high\-quality garment renderings. The candidate should have strong pattern knowledge and be capable of validating garment fit against buyer specifications and technical standards.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Create and render 3D garment models using
 **CLO 3D and/or Browzwear** 
 .
* Develop and modify digital patterns based on tech packs and buyer requirements.
* Conduct 3D fit analysis and garment evaluations against buyer specifications.
* Identify and resolve fit, construction, and pattern\-related issues before sample development.
* Generate true\-to\-life garment renderings for design reviews and customer presentations.
* Work closely with Design, Merchandising, and technical teams to ensure accuracy and timely delivery.
* Maintain digital libraries of patterns, avatars, trims, and fabrics.



**Requirements** 



* Diploma/Degree in Fashion Design, Apparel Technology, Garment Engineering, or related field.
* 3–8 years of experience in 3D apparel development.
* Hands\-on expertise in
 **CLO 3D and/or Browzwear** 
 .
* Strong understanding of garment construction, pattern making, grading, and fit.
* Ability to interpret buyer tech packs, measurement charts, and fit comments.
* Experience in conducting virtual fit sessions and recommending pattern corrections.
* Good understanding of fabrics, drape properties, and garment behavior in 3D environments.
* Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.



**Additional Requirements** 



* Willingness to work in flexible shifts to support global customers and time zones.
* Good communication skills and ability to work with cross\-functional teams.



  





**Preferred:** 
 Experience in babywear, childrenswear, knitwear, or apparel manufacturing environments.
 



  





 Interested candidates may send your resume to careers@jayjaymills.com
 **or mbhuvaneshwari@jayjaymills.in**
